name: Miyoo Flip

models.name: Flip
models.notes: Single model; RK3566, requires GammaLoader patch for SD boot

summary: Miyoo's RK3566-based Linux handheld. Requires GammaLoader patching of the stock firmware before it can boot KNULLI from SD card. Primary SD card slot is on the right side.

variants.notes: RK3566 SoC. Requires GammaLoader patch before KNULLI installation — install the Gamma Bootloader Installer from stock OS to enable SD-card boot. After patching, the primary SD card slot is on the right side. KNULLI interface: Emulation Station. No permanent damage: stock OS remains functional.

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image (knulli-rk3568-miyoo-flip); boots from SD card after GammaLoader patch.
homebrew.summary: Batocera-based retro gaming OS for the Miyoo Flip. Requires GammaLoader patch of stock firmware to enable SD-card boot.

compatibility.note: The Miyoo Flip needs a GammaLoader patch before it can boot KNULLI. KNULLI Scarab provides knulli-rk3568-miyoo-flip image. Stock OS remains intact after patching.

requirements: A good-quality SD card formatted to FAT32.
GammaLoaderMiyooFlip.zip from the GammaOS releases page.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
warnings: Follow the GammaLoader installation precisely; if the device stops booting, unbricking requires opening the shell and pressing a button on the mainboard.
After GammaLoader installation, the primary SD card slot is on the right side (not the left).
DO NOT INTERRUPT the GammaLoader installation process.

homebrew.name: ROCKNIX
homebrew.firmware: Per-model RK3566 image; boots from SD card after GammaLoader patch.
homebrew.summary: Mainline-Linux retro gaming OS for the Miyoo Flip. Requires GammaLoader patch first.

compatibility.note: ROCKNIX lists the Flip as a supported RK3566 device.

requirements: GammaLoader patch applied to stock firmware.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
warnings: GammaLoader must be installed first before any custom OS can boot from SD card.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Frontend on top of the stock OS.
homebrew.summary: Custom Python-based frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported Miyoo devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the Miyoo Flip with 'Stable' support status.

requirements: A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.
